_comment: Japanese translation overlays, joined to the English records in
articles.json by the 'source' path. A record here supplies prose only:
headline, description, next-step labels, screenshot alt text, and extra
search synonyms. Paths, canonicals, hreflang, JSON-LD, og tags, next-step
URLs, and the rendered date are all derived from the English source, and
setting any of them here is a build error.
source_hash and source_meta_hash pin the English wording this translation
was made from. build_site.py refuses to build when they drift; see the
stale_ack escape hatch in scripts/build_site.py for the survivable path
through a typo fix that does not change meaning.
